description: The plot illustrates the Macro-F1 scores for two different models, MATTER and one without material information, as the number of tokens varies during tokenization training. The x-axis represents the number of tokens, with a linear scale, ranging from approximately 0.5 to 1.5, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents the Macro-F1 score as a percentage, with a linear scale, ranging from 48 to 58, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The MATTER model is represented by a pink line with circular markers and a solid line style, starting at around 55% at 0.5 tokens and peaking at approximately 58% at 1.0 tokens before declining to around 51% at 1.5 tokens. The model without material information is represented by a purple line with circular markers and a solid line style, remaining relatively steady around 53% from 0.5 to 1.3 tokens before decreasing to around 48% at 1.5 tokens. Both lines have shaded regions indicating their respective ranges of uncertainty.
